title: Single-Demonstration Many-Shot Defense: How Many Shots Until It Breaks?

original_idea.body: Does the prefill vulnerability shrink with reasoning effort? (extends arXiv:2602.14689) Sweep thinking-token budget on one open reasoning model vs generic prefills on StrongReject; plot ASR dose-response curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether inference-time compute is a cheap prefill defense on an open-weight-specific attack surface; concrete and defensible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: One open reasoning model, ~5 prefills, StrongReject judge, budget sweep; accessible with standard tooling.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single dose-response curve with a clear ASR metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Prefill is an open-weight attack labs can't fully fix; high independent value, public models.

novelty.reasoning: Source notes reasoning robustness but not the budget dose-response; likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Reasoning-budget dose-response on prefill likely unstudied.
